_doc: The battle console mockup's test scenes for weapon targeting, point defence, arming, the fleet, the tactical map and the event log, in the format of data/battle/scenarios.json, appended to its list in menu order. Disable and Pinned fire (openspec/changes/weapon-targeting, owner 2026-11-04: disable a ship's subsystems without destroying it; pin weapons to several ships at once), each played from both sides in approved ships only: the mockup's Kethran destroyer and raiders are the Krai's ships on the Concord side and the Concord's on the Krai side. The Disable scene is won by disabling, not destroying (data/battle/systems/tactical.json objectives).

scenarios.name: Disable
scenarios.objective: Disable the Vekk's engines and weapons without destroying it
say: Take the Vekk intact: aim at its engines, then its weapons. Lances aim; torpedoes hit whatever its facing exposes.

scenarios.name: Pinned fire
scenarios.objective: Pin a weapon to each raider and destroy all three
say: Three raiders from three sides. Expand Tactical and pin a weapon to each, then fire.

scenarios.name: Disable
scenarios.objective: Disable the Meridian's engines and weapons without destroying it
say: Take the Meridian intact: aim at its engines, then its weapons. The forge and the disruptors aim; torpedoes hit whatever its facing exposes.

scenarios.name: Pinned fire
scenarios.objective: Pin a weapon to each raider and destroy all three
say: Three Concord ships from three sides. Expand Tactical and pin a weapon to each, then fire.
